title: 2 #### 1.4 The Pattern of IPC Crimes A comparative study of crimes committed under different crime heads during the period 1970—74 shows that the pattern of crime in 1970 did not vary much from the subsequent years till 1974. The percentage of 'Murder' to the total cognizable crimes during 1970 was 1-6 which remained exactly the same for subsequent years except for 1971 when a marginal increase of 0-1 per cent was registered. Similarly for a few more crimes; only marginal variations (+,-) were noticed. The detailed are presented in Table 3.
